reopening: A further-surface proposal demonstrates a second index that does not duplicate turn order (e.g. a file-centric index); reopen by Run decision with a new signature regulation naming both rails and their aria roles.
scope: all Surfaces in run scope agentic-model-chat
statement: Exactly one spine navigator per active session; exactly one node per assistant turn in chronological order; user turns are ticks, never nodes; at most one expanded well per work order.

reopening: A viewport study with two concurrent blocking states (e.g. failed ticket + running ticket both demanding action) proves one elevation insufficient; reopen by Run decision to permit a second elevation ONLY for the blocking-failure ticket, with the pair rule written here.
statement: CARD-SOUP GUARD: exactly one ticket per viewport carries elevation lift.active with the accent edge; all other tickets flat with 1px borders; tool rows never cards; spine never elevated.

reopening: WCAG guidance changes the ratio floors; reopen to re-pin the status ink values, never to remove the glyph-plus-word pairing.
scope: every status indicator: pills, nodes, tool stats, checks, carriage
statement: Status is never color-only: every state pairs color with glyph plus text label and meets AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large/graphic) via the status.* ink pairs.

reopening: A cross-session evidence view is approved as a further surface; reopen to add a session token to the stamp grammar, never to drop the turn token.
scope: wells, evidence wing header, attachment sheets
statement: Every attachment cites back with Turn NN / Kind target + status + duration; the wing header mirrors the selected ticket and re-stamps on selection change.

reopening: Retention policy or legal constraint requires failure redaction; reopen with the redaction rule and its audit trail, never silent removal.
scope: failed tickets, error boxes, spine failure nodes
statement: Failures render in place with evidence and attempt-keeping retry language; red nodes persist until retried or dismissed with a recorded reason; no toasts, no auto-dismiss.

reopening: A new evidence kind arrives that prose cannot carry (e.g. audio trace); reopen to extend the mono-ration list by Decision, never by ad-hoc faces.
statement: Grotesk for jobs/chrome/composer, mono strictly for targets/commands/durations/citations, condensed numerals for order; no new face or hue-coded category without a Decision.

reopening: A new status or diff semantic is proven necessary (e.g. partial-failure); reopen to add the pair with its glyph+word, never a bare hue.
statement: Saturated color means status or diff only; grounds stay neutral; no AI gradient, glow, shimmer, or decorative hue anywhere on the Surface.

reopening: Breakpoint range shifts by Run decision (e.g. 360px floor); reopen to re-pin the width table, never to permit page-level horizontal scroll or an unreachable composer.
statement: No horizontal page scroll at any width; keep-status/hide-duration at <=480px; sticky-bottom composer below 820px; 44px minimum targets everywhere; strip/drawer/footnote translations per the variant table.
